description: Which posted patches carry a line: searches the + and - lines of every patch posted to the lists (attached or inline, every version) for an identifier, line or hunk (REGBUF_NO_CHANGE, `heap_page_prune_opt(Relation relation, Buffer buffer`). One entry per series (thread), by first appearance: first_version and latest_version carrying it (message_id, date, from, version, patch files with download urls, matching lines and their path), how many messages carry it, and commit: the commit that landed it (sha, date) by its Discussion: link, or null. Words match from a word start; whitespace runs match any whitespace (pgindent); several lines must all be changed lines of one file. complete=false (cut says why) when a common word hit the read cap or the budget ran out. Not search_patches ([PATCH vN m/k] subjects). Read a version with get_attachment or the urls.

query.description: Identifier, line or hunk (at most 32 changed lines; repeats count once). A leading + or - names that line's side

name: search_patch_lines
